name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) with Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) forces the key, as the task's 'take the key, then open the door' requires, so no separate Existence(has_door_key) is needed. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) is hard because 'after that' is an order word that stays hard, and the soft Existence(target_picked_up) correctly scopes only the 'try to pick up the box' step.

texts: Open the door (the door must be unlocked and open at some point)
Take the key before opening the door (the door can only be opened after the key is held)
After the door is opened, pick up the box in the other room (ordering requirement, the box pickup itself is only preferred)
Try to pick up the target box in the other room
